datasheet.title: LM2596 SIMPLE SWITCHER® Power Converter 150-kHz 3-A Step-Down Voltage Regulator

notes: These are physical IC datasheet specifications. The scoped OpenPE adjustable simulation derivative is not a TI-issued ADJ model; these specifications do not validate that derivative.
Output range and output current are device capabilities, not measured values for this example.

input_voltage.conditions: Use within the stated operating limits and the application requirements.

output_voltage.conditions: Application capability stated in the datasheet; external components, input voltage and temperature constrain usable operation.

output_current.conditions: Application capability stated in the datasheet; external components, input voltage and temperature constrain usable operation.

operating_junction_temperature.conditions: Operating temperature; interpreted as junction temperature consistently with the electrical-characteristic limits.

input_voltage_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

junction_temperature_absolute_maximum.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

storage_temperature.conditions: Stress limit only; functional operation is not implied.

feedback_reference_voltage.conditions: Adjustable version, TJ = 25 degC; VIN = 4.5 to 40 V, ILOAD = 0.2 to 3 A; VOUT programmed for 3 V; Figure 9-13.

switching_frequency.conditions: VIN = 12 V, ILOAD = 0.5 A, TJ = 25 degC unless the row specifies otherwise. Frequency reduces under second-stage current limit.

source.section: 7.9 Electrical Characteristics - All Output Voltage Versions

switch_current_limit.conditions: VIN = 12 V, ILOAD = 0.5 A, TJ = 25 degC unless the row specifies otherwise. No diode, inductor or capacitor on the output pin; feedback forced to 0 V (footnotes 4 and 5).

source.section: 7.9 Electrical Characteristics - All Output Voltage Versions

quiescent_current.conditions: VIN = 12 V, ILOAD = 0.5 A, TJ = 25 degC unless the row specifies otherwise. Feedback disconnected from output and tied to 12 V to force switch off (footnote 6).

source.section: 7.9 Electrical Characteristics - All Output Voltage Versions

shutdown_current.conditions: TJ = 25 degC, VIN = 40 V, ON/OFF pin = 5 V (off); footnote 7.

source.section: 7.9 Electrical Characteristics - All Output Voltage Versions

maximum_duty_cycle.conditions: VIN = 12 V, ILOAD = 0.5 A, TJ = 25 degC unless the row specifies otherwise. Feedback forced to 0 V; footnote 5.

source.section: 7.9 Electrical Characteristics - All Output Voltage Versions
